_comment: Single source of truth for the four JMeter plans. build_plans.py writes plans/*.jmx from 'properties'. run_suite.py applies 'smoke' when --profile smoke is used. 'thresholds' are pass/fail limits checked by analyze.py.

benchmark.description: One user, repeated sessions, no pauses: the response times of an idle server.

load.description: Ramped load: 25 users join over 2 minutes, then keep working for 15 minutes with a one-second pause between actions.

stress.description: Past expected capacity: up to 200 users over 10 minutes. The goal is to find where errors or slow responses begin.

endurance.description: Two hours with 15 users. Memory and garbage-collection pauses are watched for a steady rise, which can mean a leak.
